enabled.name: Switch music automatically
enabled.hint: When enabled, music changes automatically when the active scene changes and when combat starts or ends.

defaultExplore.name: Default music (no combat)
defaultExplore.hint: Plays on every scene that has no exploration music of its own.

defaultCombat.name: Default combat music
defaultCombat.hint: Plays during combat on every scene that has no combat music of its own.

fadeDuration.name: Transition duration (seconds)
fadeDuration.hint: How long the old track fades out and the new one fades in. 0 = hard cut.

transition.name: Transition type
transition.hint: Sequential: fade out completely, then fade in the new track. Crossfade: both at the same time.

fadeScope.name: Which music is faded out on a switch?
fadeScope.hint: With the first option, ambience playlists stay untouched if their channel is set to "Environment".
fadeScope.managed: Only those started by Music Switcher

scene.hint: Music for this scene. Plays when the scene is activated and when combat on it starts or ends.

notify.missing: Music Switcher: The configured playlist or track no longer exists.
notify.empty: Music Switcher: The configured playlist has no tracks.
